mapper.select: SELECT A.AMENITY_SN, A.AMENITY_CTGRY_CD, A.APPLY_SCOPE_CD, A.AMENITY_NM, A.AMENITY_KEY, A.ICON_KEY, A.SORT_SEQ, A.USE_YN, A.CUSTOM_YN FROM ROOM_AMENITY RA JOIN AMENITY_MST A ON A.AMENITY_SN = RA.AMENITY_SN AND A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND A.APPLY_SCOPE_CD IN ('ROOM','BOTH') WHERE RA.ROOM_SN = #{roomSn} AND RA.DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY A.AMENITY_CTGRY_CD, A.SORT_SEQ, A.AMENITY_SN
SELECT RA.AMENITY_SN FROM ROOM_AMENITY RA JOIN AMENITY_MST A ON A.AMENITY_SN = RA.AMENITY_SN AND A.DEL_YN = 'N' WHERE RA.ROOM_SN = #{roomSn} AND RA.DEL_YN = 'N'
